277916631.description: This listing features a set of three vintage wooden tobacco pipes, likely made of briar wood. Each pipe has a distinct curved stem crafted from different materials, including plastic and possibly Bakelite. The set includes one pipe with a decorative orange-toned mouthpiece, another with a light-colored section and a classic design, and a third with a rustic, carved appearance. All pipes show visible signs of use such as darkened bowls and some wear. Any condition issues are visible in the photos. These pipes are suitable for collectors of vintage smoking accessories and tobacciana. See photos for condition details.
